title: AI-Based eXtended Reality Training for Automation
summary: BSD design proposes AI-supported extended-reality training to improve workers' automation skills. Learning, production, and onboarding outcomes are not reported.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: BSD design is developing AI-supported extended-reality training to improve workers’ automation skills. Learning, production, and onboarding outcomes remain unreported.
purpose: Help industrial workers acquire skills for automated production.

ratings.reason: Industrial workers are intended to gain automation skills and problem-solving capability.
Manufacturers and trainers are intended to improve onboarding and reduce rework; no observed result is supplied.

ai_role.statement: The account does not separately assess AI’s contribution to the benefit.

evidence.citation: International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025). Project-submitted account, current as of June 2025. ITU provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 10: AI-Based eXtended Reality Training for Automation

produced_by: The account does not separately establish the conditions responsible for the benefit.
must_hold: The account does not establish specific replication requirements.

headline: XR training for industrial automation
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
